text: I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To determine the underlying cause, have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes), dark urine, or pale stools recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, sexual activity with multiple partners, and these liver symptoms, are you currently taking any immunosuppressive medications, and have you experienced any changes in bowel habits or abdominal pain lately?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

The presence of scleral icterus, severe pruritus, and fatigue, combined with a history of autoimmune conditions like ulcerative colitis, strongly suggests an autoimmune cholestatic liver disease. I will proceed with specific serological testing to confirm this. REQUEST TEST: Anti-mitochondrial antibody (AMA). REQUEST TEST: Alkaline Phosphatase and GGT levels.
